Russia Launches Drone and Missile Strikes Across Ukraine

Russia conducted widespread drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, hitting targets in the capital Kyiv and other regions. In Kyiv, strikes impacted the historic center and a school, with one report indicating the Kyiv Science Academy was hit. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stated that the attacks killed seven people and targeted the power grid. CCTV footage captured a Russian drone hitting a school in Kyiv. Separately, a drone crashed in Moldova during the overnight attacks on Ukraine.
